projects.title: Weston output management enhancements
projects.short_description: Making   Weston   able   to   start   without   any   outputs   present   and   survive   when   all   outputs   have   been  disconnected.  ...
projects.description:
• Making Weston able to start without any outputs present and survive when all outputs have been disconnected.
  • Implementing output layout configuration, so Weston can support extended screens.
  • Writing some automatic tests so they can ensure that implemented features mentioned above won’t get broken during future development.
